selected_script.angle: Organizing frequently used spices and kitchen canisters on the flat side of a chest freezer in a cramped pantry
selected_script.hook: Stop digging through deep shelves every time you need one spice jar.

script_record.pain_point: Digging through deep cabinet shelves looking for a tiny spice jar
script_record.conflict_hook: Stop digging through deep shelves every time you need one spice jar.
script_record.product_solution: Heavy-duty matte black magnetic spice rack set snaps onto any metal surface for vertical storage.

timeline.scene: A person is digging through a deep, messy pantry cabinet, knocking over spices and looking frustrated. No product and no rescuer.

timeline.purpose: 荒诞成年亲属携产品入场
timeline.scene: A grandfather wearing a bright yellow ski jacket and ski goggles enters carrying the exact matte black magnetic rack, takes it directly to the side of a white chest freezer, and says: 'Use this instead!'
The rack snaps magnetically onto the side of the chest freezer, holding three spice jars instantly.
A close-up of the organized side of the freezer with spice jars neatly lined up in the matte black rack.
The rack attached to the side of a washing machine holding laundry detergent bottles with keys hanging from the detachable metal hooks.
A clean, organized kitchen with multiple matte black racks on the side of a refrigerator, holding oils, spices, and oven mitts on the hooks.
Text overlay: 'Make your space cleaner and cozier.' with a clean shot of the racks.

script_record.cta: Make your space cleaner and cozier.
